top_signals.title: Where Is OPEC+? Riyadh and Moscow’s Silence Is Becoming Deafening
top_signals.summary: “The roar of the engines does not herald true dominance, but the absolute silence that precedes the strike." “Let your plans be dark and impenetrable as night, and when you move, fall like a thunderbolt."
